summary: GTest coverage was significantly expanded around stream changes, frame-rate estimation, decode-error recovery, MP3 average-length edge cases, and encoder/decoder behaviors (including WebRTC/H.264 and real-time 4K encode scenarios). By exercising frame-rate, stream-ID transitions, and encoder/decoder edge cases in unit tests, these additions help prevent regressions in video timing, seeking, and real-time encode/decode paths.
